task: French-grape leaf binary visual screening: source-labeled Esca vs source-labeled Healthy

model.output: raw logits converted to softmax scores; scores are not calibrated probabilities

trainingData.attribution: Shikalgar et al. (2026), GVLiD, Mendeley Data V5
trainingData.sourceVineyards: The paper reports 34 farms/vineyards; 28 vineyard IDs are represented in the curated 1,323-image subset used here.
trainingData.splitMethod: Vineyard-disjoint: test Vineyard_1, Vineyard_8, Vineyard_15, Vineyard_22; validation Vineyard_4, Vineyard_11, Vineyard_18, Vineyard_25; remaining vineyards train.
trainingData.manifestRecovery: The 3,477-row source inventory and 1,323-row curated manifest were reconstructed from the source metadata/checksum/quality files. SHA256 matched for all 1,323 retained image files; reconstructed split counts exactly match the saved training summary.

audit.note: The source quality table flags all 3,477 rows as blurry; this flag is non-discriminating and was not used as a blanket exclusion. Per-row exclusion reasons are recorded where evidence is available; otherwise the source row remains excluded/quarantined.

inDomainEvaluation.warning: These are results on the India GVLiD vineyard-held-out split, not Syrian field accuracy. The restored manifest reproduces the split counts and metrics, but this is still a source-specific test.

pilotOperatingPoint.selectionNote: Conservative exploratory threshold. Validation distributions were reviewed; threshold exploration also inspected the held-out test distributions, so report the test operating-point values as exploratory rather than a preregistered untouched threshold test.

externalOpenSetProbe.dataset: Grape Leaf Health Mendeley V1, DOI 10.17632/378c69nwk5.1
externalOpenSetProbe.interpretation: This dataset contains no Esca examples. It measures false Esca alerts on healthy and other-disease proxy classes only; it cannot measure external Esca sensitivity or overall accuracy.
limitations: Folder-derived source labels are not equivalent to expert confirmation for every individual leaf.
The external set is not a Syrian dataset and contains no Esca-positive samples.
False Esca alerts on other disease categories are an open-set probe, not a complete external classification accuracy measure.

appQualityGateApproximation.method: Python emulation of the current leafScreening.ts acceptance thresholds; browser pipeline was separately smoke-tested on representative examples.
appQualityGateApproximation.warning: Approximate quality-gate emulation, not a full browser run over all 515 images. Rejection coverage is substantial: 47.4% of this external dataset did not pass image-quality checks.

calibrationExperiment.decision: Temperature scaling was not enabled. It sharply increased confidence on external unseen-disease images and worsened false Esca alert rates; the pilot uses raw softmax scores only, explicitly labeled as uncalibrated model scores.

acceptanceDecision.reason: The limited two-class pilot is useful for early experimentation, but it does not detect other grape diseases, has no Syrian field validation, lacks a clean preregistered external Esca-positive test, and still shows open-set false alerts. It must remain clearly marked as experimental and must never label the leaf healthy.

rollback.previousBehavior: Color-based screening only; no active ONNX model
rollback.rollbackAction: Set enabled=false in public/models/plant-disease/manifest.json and revert the pilot integration commit if runtime or user-facing behavior regresses.
